a.description: input array, representing a (batched) positive-definite hermitian matrix. Must have shape ``(..., N, N)``.

lower.description: if True, compute the lower triangular Cholesky decomposition (default: False).

output.description: ``(c, lower)``: ``c`` is an array of shape ``(..., N, N)`` representing the lower or upper cholesky decomposition of the input; ``lower`` is a boolean specifying whether this is the lower or upper decomposition.
